title: 1946 military search of Swedish lakes for ghost rockets
summary: Clas Svahn tells of 1946 military search of Swedish lakes for ghost rockets, about 1946 at Lakes around Sweden, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
And in 1946, as we talked about the
ghost rockets, uh, the military were
looking for them in several different
lakes around Sweden. All they found were
indentations at the bottom.

plain: Clas Svahn, a researcher who keeps a large collection of UFO records, tells of the 'ghost rockets', rocket-like objects reported over Sweden in 1946. He says the military searched several lakes around Sweden for them, thinking some had come down. All they found, he says, were dents in the lake bottoms, which would suggest something did hit the water.
